title: Event Store, Trajectories and Provenance

control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The repaired read-only repository-agent proof passed without per_user_worktree_quota. The bounded mutating delegation remained deterministically blocked by the stale promotion target (zetsu_agent_apply_target_not_clean); the documented local fallback was used. The production control-plane checkout was not modified.

implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore exposes append_trajectory_event, replay_trajectory and checkpoint_trajectory; the Operator API supplies local operator-state persistence when it constructs Core.
implementation.storage: Owner-bound append-only JSONL events with a SHA-256 chain and one atomic derived JSON checkpoint; no database, model, network or cloud dependency was added.
invariants: Events carry owner, project, session and task identity.
Every event carries bounded typed provenance and state-before/state-after hashes.
Replay validates schema, event IDs, idempotency keys, sequence, hash chain and state transitions.
Checkpoints are validated acceleration snapshots; intact events remain authoritative.
Exact duplicate idempotency keys return the original immutable event; conflicting reuse fails closed.
Unknown schema versions, complete corruption, duplicate records, state conflicts and cross-owner access fail closed.
Only an unterminated final crash fragment is quarantined and recovered; complete malformed records are never silently discarded.

persistence_and_recovery.restart_resume: A new TrajectoryService instance reconstructed the exact state from the event log.
persistence_and_recovery.checkpoint: A valid checkpoint was used as an acceleration snapshot; a corrupt checkpoint was ignored and the intact trajectory replayed exactly.
persistence_and_recovery.crash_during_append: An injected crash after a partial final write quarantined the fragment; the next replay recovered an empty pre-append state and accepted the next event.
persistence_and_recovery.crash_between_event_and_checkpoint: An injected checkpoint crash left the already durable event authoritative; restart replay returned the exact post-event state.
persistence_and_recovery.cancellation: task_cancelled is a typed replayable event and survives checkpoint/restart.
persistence_and_recovery.migration: Schema version 1 is current; unknown versions fail closed and future versions require explicit transforms through migrate().

limitations: G5 is certified in SHADOW lifecycle because existing agent execution has not yet been migrated to emit every event automatically; the standalone Core API is available and tested.
Trajectory state is a bounded JSON object and callers must provide deterministic state_after values; the service does not infer state from model text.
The local JSONL store is single-trajectory per service root; deployment code must allocate a separate state-root path per trajectory scope.

The existing Zetsu repository-agent registry remains stale relative to the current v2 checkout; local implementation was used after the deterministic promotion-target failure recorded in prior certifications.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the unchanged selected suite passed under that permission.
The full G0 production certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.
